content:
Aisha (CS): Kicking off planning for 'Renewal Ramp Labs' 12 sessions for Q1 renewals — focused enablement for customers with upcoming renewals. Aim: onboarding gaps, runbook handoff, and action items for renewal playbooks. Need volunteers for facilitation, lab helpers, and one SRE per session.
Marco (CS): Sounds good. Recommend 90min blocks: 45min guided lab + 30min troubleshooting + 15min next-steps. Can cover EMEA slots.
Priya (Solutions): I'll run the migration + Dedicated tuning lab. Need sample customer configs ahead of time. Can also produce a 1-page cheat sheet.
Devon (PM): I've exported the renewal cohort with health scores to drive: https://drive.redwood/renewal-cohort-q1. Suggest we prioritize low-health accounts in week 1.
Aisha (CS): Polling preferred days/times now (please mark ALL that work). We'll run two batches over two consecutive weeks. Also want a dedicated "at-risk" slot on day 1.
scheduler-bot: Poll live  https://polls.redwood/renewal-ramp (expires 48h) :pushpin: 
Zoe (CS): Volunteering for morning APAC-friendly sessions (UTC+9). Happy to co-facilitate hands-on labs.
Nate (SRE): I'll join as SRE cover for any infra debugging. Prefer to be on-call for the Tues/Thur sessions. Please cc my calendar.
Marco (CS): Prework ask: customers should run a short inference smoke test and paste raw token/latency rows into the prework form. I'll draft the prework with curl example.
Aisha (CS): Draft prework snippet to paste in invite: 
```
# smoke test (prework)
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/infer \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-std","input":"test prompt 1","max_tokens":32}' | jq '.usage, .latency_ms'
```
Priya (Solutions): Also ask for peak sequence length + 95th pct concurrent requests. That helps us pick batching & quantization configs.
Devon (PM): I've bucketed accounts into priority tiers and attached CSV to the drive link. Will share proposed invite seeds after poll closes.
Aisha (CS): Agenda skeleton: 5min intros, 15min health/checklist triage, 45min guided lab (customer runs migration steps), 20min cost/latency tuning clinic, 5min wrap + post-session actions. We'll keep to 90min max.
Zoe (CS): Suggest a 10-min "what to expect" doc for customers so they join prepared. I can draft that.
Marco (CS): We should include a short post-session feedback capture (emoji + 3 quick q's). I can wire a simple form.
Aisha (CS): Great. I'll consolidate volunteers and assign facilitator pairs. Plan to seed invites Wednesday evening once poll sorted. If anyone can't make the slot they volunteered for, please update the poll annotation. :white_check_mark:
